tests.method: Three actual, disjoint pytest batches: original 751, new focused tests, and new campaign tests. Combined XML is their union, not a fourth execution.

operation_outcomes.scope: These are aggregate operation assessments, not a count of individual battles or automatic fulfillment of political war aims.

political_replacement_receipts.scope: The fixed campaign controller explicitly authorizes its replacement orders. Independent NPC replenishment/defer/reduce decisions are covered by separate genuine unit/API tests, not silently claimed as autonomous national war planning.

performance.method: Sequential actual SQLite Engine, daily full auditing; same initial economies and actors. Military activation, supplies, combat, training and resulting NPC/Crisis responses have real costs; this is feature overhead, not an identical-outcome optimization comparison.

immutable_archive_integrity.method: Read-only all-blob decompression/length/SHA/canonical JSON, catalog/head and political metadata identity, SQLite integrity/foreign keys; no simulation.
